messages:
alejandra (AE): Hi team — HelixPay (fintech POC) sent the security questionnaire + traffic profile. They want a clear capacity and pricing comparison (reserved vs burst) for their 6-week POC. Baseline ~200 RPS, spike windows to 800 RPS for 10-15m, avg request ~4k tokens. Must support VPC peering, CMK (customer-managed KMS), and audit logs.

mike (Solutions): Quick q: are the spikes simultaneous global or limited to us-west-2? Also do they need warm session affinity (long-lived convs)?

alejandra (AE): Spikes are US-west driven. Yes, session affinity for chat for fraud analysts (sessions can be ~30min).

dan (Infra): Rough math: 800 RPS * 4k tokens = 3.2M tokens/sec. With L40S-48GB in our tests, well-batched q4_0-13B achieves ~30-35k tokens/sec/GPU. Naive GPU count would be ~100 GPUs — but with KV prefix reuse and session caching we can get 4x reduction in effective tokens. Plan: baseline reserved pool to cover 200 RPS, autoscale to handle spikes. Recommend baseline = 10 L40S, autoscale max = 30 L40S, prewarm 4 nodes before cutover. Model recommendation: 13B q4_0 (primary), 7B q4 fallback.

maya (SRE): Sizing note: baseline 10 GPUs (handles ~180-220 RPS with good batching + caching). Autoscale params: min=10, max=30, scale_up_step=5, scale_down_step=3, cooldown=50s, prewarm=4. We'll use session-affinity sticky routing and async-KV priming.

rachel (Pricing): For a 6-week POC I can offer a blended reserved+burst quote: commit to 10 reserved, with burst cap hours to limit costs. I'll prepare two rows: Hosted Dedicated (reserved 10, burst to 30) and Private (same + infra surcharge + CMK). Need expected burst hours per month estimate.

sec-bot: Security blurb: VPC peering supported for Dedicated and Private. CMK supported in Private via KMS integration; hosted can use Redwood-managed or customer KMS with specific contract. Audit logs: request-level logs with 90d retention available as add-on. Recommend Private for regulated payment data.

mike (Solutions): Operational fallback: If autoscale cannot catch up, we route to a smaller-model pool (2x7B) and enable response truncation for very long completions. Also add model-hedging: 10% sampled requests still hit 13B for quality monitoring during fallback.

dan (Infra): Autoscale JSON we can share with their ops team: 
```
{
  "autoscale": {
    "min_gpus": 10,
    "max_gpus": 30,
    "scale_up_step": 5,
    "scale_down_step": 3,
    "cooldown_sec": 50,
    "prewarm_nodes": 4,
    "routing_policy": "latency_priority",
    "kv_preheat": { "top_sessions": 500 }
  }
}
```
Include health-checks: KV hit ratio >70% before final traffic cutover.

maya (SRE): Failure modes to call out in runbook: cloud quota exhausted (fall back to queue with graceful degradation), KV cold start (fallback to stateless 7B), and model OOMs (auto-evict large-batch). I'll draft the runbook and chaos checklist.

alejandra (AE): HelixPay asked about latency SLOs: p95 < 900ms, p99 < 3s. Can we commit to p95 for interactive flows under planned config?

maya (SRE): With 13B q4_0 and aggressive batching most interactive flows will meet p95 ~600-900ms. Long 4k completions will push p95 higher — we'll propose an SLO with token-size carveouts and include p99 targets with caveats.

rachel (Pricing): I'll send a sample cost delta: reserved 10 L40S ~ $NNk/mo vs on-demand burst to 30 could triple infra token costs during heavy months. For POC we can structure a time-limited discount on burst rate and include 5 preheat credits. Exact numbers after perf results.

mike (Solutions): I'll run a perf sim today: baseline 200 RPS, 800 RPS spikes for 15m, with session affinity and kv caching enabled. Will share latency CSV + GPU util traces. perf-bot schedule below.

perf-bot: Scheduled job: sim-helixpay -> staging-cluster at 2026-05-07T14:00Z (triggered by mike). Collecting p50/p95/p99, token/sec, kv_hit_ratio.

alejandra (AE): Action items: dan/mike run perf at 10/20/30 GPUs and produce CSVs; rachel prepare two-line pricing draft; maya draft SRE runbook + chaos checklist; sec-bot attach KMS/SOC2 blurb. I'll send HelixPay a one-pager comparing HostedReserved vs PrivateReserved with bullet pros/cons.

dan (Infra): I'll also include a q3 quantization run to show latency vs cost tradeoff (q3 reduces GPU need ~25% but may lose some quality).

maya (SRE): I'll include rollback policy: immediate rollback on error-rate >2% or p95 degradation >30% during canary; fallback to 7B pool + region failover plan.

alejandra (AE): Thanks—please target EOD tomorrow for perf CSV + draft pricing. HelixPay wants to decide by Monday.

rachel (Pricing): Will do.
